ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels limited to surface specks and edge highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity pigmentation across both visible lobes; absence of large contiguous geometric color blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated acute interior angle of approximately 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the linear boundary of both lobes with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve trajectory extending from the median notch to the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of numerous small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged wear patterns and minor indentations localized at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the central peduncle-fluke interface by high-intensity white water spray and turbulent surface wake.
